findings.summary: Tessaline achieves higher BLEU than Varrow-NMT on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, with a statistically significant mean paired difference of 0.8 BLEU points (95% CI [0.2, 1.44], p=0.017).
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 seeds paired by seed
findings.caveats: Significance is based on a paired t-test; the effect size is small (0.8 points) and may not be practically important.

findings.summary: Tessaline substantially outperforms the PhraseGrid baseline in BLEU, with a statistically significant mean paired difference of 6.35 BLEU points (95% CI [5.87, 6.83], p<0.001).
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, BLEU, 8 seeds paired by seed
findings.caveats: PhraseGrid is a reference baseline, not the primary comparison.

findings.summary: Tessaline also shows higher chrF than both Varrow-NMT and PhraseGrid on the same test set, but no statistical test was reported for chrF differences.
findings.scope: Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, chrF, 8 seeds
findings.caveats: No significance test was provided for chrF; differences may not be reliable.

sentences.text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 ± 0.6 vs. 27.6 ± 0.8), a statistically significant mean paired difference of 0.8 BLEU points (paired t-test, p = 0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44]).
Tessaline also substantially outperformed the PhraseGrid baseline in BLEU, with a statistically significant mean paired difference of 6.35 points (paired t-test, p < 0.001, 95% CI [5.87, 6.83]).
Tessaline showed higher mean chrF than both Varrow-NMT and PhraseGrid (58.1 ± 0.8 vs. 57.7 ± 0.5 and 52.4 ± 0.5, respectively), although no statistical test was reported for these chrF differences.
